dex.entry: Cloverkit's kindled middle form — a young grove buck whose first antlers have budded as soft green sprigs, each tipped with a tiny folded clover not yet in bloom. Gangly and brave, it stands its ground before it really has the size for it, glowing faintly where the clover gathers what light remains.

art.silhouette: Young leaf-deer, lime-and-deep-green coat with cream chest; slender budding antlers as curling green sprigs tipped with folded clovers; the head-clover from its kit days now worn like a small crown sprout; long legs, big dark earnest eyes. Between Cloverkit's sprout-cub and Cloverhart's broad clover-crowned stag at 64px.
